title: Resource-id UiEvents and structured target and reminder labels
lead: Split out of S18 so that S18 only moves Compose text. This slice removes English from the layers that have no `Context`: the ViewModel, the analytics and the notification code.
findings_note: TrackerAnalytics.kt:172-190 (English formatTarget/formatReminder, 24-hour time); TrackerViewModel.kt (English messages); ReminderScheduler.kt:60-81 (English channel and notification text)
boundary: **Not in this slice:** moving Compose `Text("…")` literals to resources (S18), translations, and accessibility labels (S45).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- ViewModel messages are English strings. A ViewModel has no `Context`, so it cannot use resources; it must emit resource ids.
- `TrackerAnalytics.formatTarget` and `formatReminder` build English labels with a hardcoded `%02d:%02d` 24-hour time and English weekday names, so they can never be localized and ignore the 12-hour setting.
- The notification channel name, description, title fallback and text are English literals.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
JVM, in `TrackerAnalyticsTest`:
- `summary exposes target period and value and the enabled reminder` (a COUNT tracker with a WEEKLY target of 3 and an enabled reminder at 07:30 on Monday and Friday: `targetPeriod == WEEKLY`, `targetValue == 3.0`, `reminder.hourOfDay == 7`, `reminder.daysOfWeek == setOf(MONDAY, FRIDAY)`)
- `summary has a null reminder when the reminder is disabled`
Delete any existing assertion on `targetLabel` or `reminderLabel`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. `UiEvent`: change `Message(text: String)`, `Logged(text, …)`, `Cleared(text, …)` and S15's `Archived(text, …)` to carry `@StringRes val textRes: Int` and `val args: List<Any> = emptyList()` instead of `text`. In `MainScreen`, resolve them with `context.getString(event.textRes, *event.args.toTypedArray())` before calling `showSnackbar`. The Undo action label is `R.string.action_undo`.
2. Convert every message in `TrackerViewModel` to a string resource named `event_…` (for example `event_tracker_created`, `event_logged` with `%1$s` for the tracker name). The one exception is the backup import error: pass the `BackupFormatException` message as the argument of `event_import_failed` ("Backup import failed: %1$s"), and add the code comment `// BackupCodec messages are English and not localized.`
3. `TrackerSummary`: remove `targetLabel` and `reminderLabel`. Add `targetPeriod: TargetPeriod?`, `targetValue: Double?` and `reminder: ReminderConfig?` (non-null only when a reminder exists and is enabled). Delete `formatTarget`, `formatReminder` and the private `formatNumber` from `TrackerAnalytics`.
4. `ui/Labels.kt` has two `@Composable` functions that build the display text from resources:
   - `targetLabel(type, period, value, unit)`: "1 per day" for YES_NO DAILY, "3 days per week" for YES_NO WEEKLY (plurals), "8 glasses per day" for COUNT. Numbers via `NumberRules.formatNumber`.
   - `reminderLabel(config)`: time with `LocalTime.of(h, m).format(DateTimeFormatter.ofLocalizedTime(FormatStyle.SHORT))`; days with `DayOfWeek.getDisplayName(TextStyle.SHORT, Locale.getDefault())` in `WeekFields.of(Locale.getDefault()).firstDayOfWeek` order; "Every day at %1$s" when the set is empty or has all seven days, otherwise "%1$s at %2$s".
   Replace every use of the removed fields in the dashboard card and the detail header with these functions.
5. `ReminderScheduler`: channel name and description, the notification title fallback and the text come from `context.getString(R.string.notification_…)`.
6. Add every new string to `values/strings.xml` with the prefixes `event_`, `action_`, `label_`, `notification_`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` passes.
- `rg -n '"[A-Z][a-z]+ [a-z]' app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/TrackerViewModel.kt app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/TrackerAnalytics.kt app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/ReminderScheduler.kt` finds no English sentences (apart from log tags or the code comment in step 2).
- Manual: with the device set to 12-hour time, a reminder label reads "8:00 PM"; with 24-hour time it reads "20:00". Each snackbar still shows, with Undo where it had it.
